summary.fr: Sur le patch 16.21, Pantheon support affiche 48,6 % de victoires sur 846 parties classées (Émeraude+), tier B. Il souffre surtout contre Nautilus, Leona et Thresh.
summary.en: On patch 16.21, Pantheon support has a 48.6% win rate over 846 ranked games (Emerald+), B tier. It struggles most against Nautilus, Leona and Thresh.
